- **Vision and image models are recognized from real data**: the model sheet and the composer no longer guess "text only" from a name prefix. On Ollama the local server declares what each installed model accepts (`/api/show` → `capabilities`), so `gemma3`, `qwen3-vl` and anything you pull tomorrow get the image attachment; on the cloud providers the model specs come from the public OpenRouter catalog (matched by id), so a vision or image-generation model that was never in our curated table is now detected.
- **Search models right in the chat**: the model sheet has the search field on its first level — type and the full list filters in place. No more trip to Settings to search a model.
- **The fetched catalog is remembered**: "Fetch models" now stores the provider's catalog, so the chat sheet reaches any model that exists, even one you never marked as active. The catalog is fetched once in the background the first time you open the sheet (and never re-fetched after that).
- **Specs cache actually gets filled**: the live capability overlay was dead code since the UI migration — nothing wrote to it. It now runs on startup for your active and favorite models (zero network once warm) and after every model scan.
